vat_standard_percent.note: Raised from 20 % to 23 % on 1 January 2025 (Act No. 278/2024 Z. z., amending Act No. 222/2004 Z. z.).

inspection_label.note: The emission check (EK) is a separate inspection on the same cadence; PRD 13 writes the pair TK + EK, and Vehicles (plan item 81) schedules both.

name.note: The English is the Office's own (dataprotection.gov.sk/en), whose footer also writes Personal Data Protection Office of the Slovak Republic. Czech, German and Polish have no established name for it, and carry the Slovak one.

url.note: The Office's page on its proceedings: a complaint is a proposal to start them (návrh na začatie konania), and the page says how one is made, what it must say, and gives its form. In Slovak only.
